title: Cartier-preserving pullback of the canonical boundary
statement: For n>0 and finite A killed by n there is one OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] such that the canonical classes [def-sfb-geo-cartier-canonical-class] satisfy the pro-etale base-change square [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface] for every Cartesian square of effective Cartier immersions with n invertible on both bases. The specified counit-mate exchange is invertible.

proof.text: Construct one simultaneous OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport from etaleFiniteTwistPullback: take the degree-one line maps, their roots inclusion equations, and pure tensor normalization. This construction is independent of the Cartier immersion and square.

Apply finite base change to the closed immersion and compose with the constant inverse-image isomorphism to show that supportedConstantExchange is invertible. The closed-exchange comparison identity expresses pullback of the supported source comparison followed by geoCartierExchange as a composite of isomorphisms. Cancel the source comparison to obtain invertibility of the actual pro-etale exchange.

Apply supported_kummer_boundary_pullback to geoCartierEtaleClass and its boundary specifications for the given normalized transport. Apply exact comparison inverse image to this Ext square. Naturality of Ext under the inverse-image comparison isomorphism identifies the two iterated exact-functor maps. Precompose with the inverse source comparison; the closed-exchange comparison identity and the inverse identities cancel both supported-source comparisons. Associativity of Ext composition then gives the required square for geoCartierCanonicalClass and the specified geoCartierLinePullback.

lean.statement:
theorem geoCartierCanonicalClass_pullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) :
    ∃ t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A n hA,
      ∀ {D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ Z) (i' : D' ⟶ Z')
        [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i'] (g : Z' ⟶ Z) (gD : D' ⟶ D)
        (sq : IsPullback gD i' i g) (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) (hI' : i'.ker.IsInvertible)
        (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) (hZ' : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z', ⊤))),
        IsIso (geoCartierExchange A i i' g gD sq.toCommSq) ∧
        (Ext.mk₀ (geoCartierExchange A i i' g gD sq.toCommSq)).comp
            (geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i' hI' hZ') (zero_add 2) =
          ((geoCartierCanonicalClass A n hn hA i hI hZ).mapExactFunctor
            (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g)).comp
            (Ext.mk₀ (geoCartierLinePullback A n hA t g hZ).hom) (add_zero 2)
